Quick Tokyo Disney question: you can afford one night at Maihama. Do you spend it before your park day or after? There's an official rule that decides it for many families 👇

📌 Save this for your trip (the full guide is here) 👉 https://japanbystation.com/tokyo-disney-hotel-night-before-or-after

🅰️ NIGHT BEFORE

Only worth it at one of the six Disney hotels. Their Happy Entry gets you into Tokyo Disneyland 15 minutes before other guests, and Tokyo Disney Resort says it works every day of the stay except check-in day.

Each guest aged 4 or over gets a pass. The page is honest that 15 minutes isn't guaranteed when the hotel entrance is busy.

🅱️ NIGHT AFTER

Our pick for the Official Hotels (Hilton Tokyo Bay, Sheraton Grande and friends). They have no early entry, so the morning is the same either way.

After the 21:00 closing, you ride the Disney Resort Line to Bayside Station and take the free shuttle bus. On Thu 17 Dec the Sheraton was ¥40,000 for 2 adults and a 6-year-old on Booking.com.

🧳 SMALL PRINT WORTH KNOWING

Disney hotel rates aren't on Booking.com, so compare them on the official site for your own dates.

A few dates are excluded from Happy Entry for some hotels. At Tokyo Disneyland, 12 January 2027 is one of them for MiraCosta, Fantasy Chateau and Celebration Hotel guests.

💡 THE TIE-BREAKER

From Tokyo Station, Tokyo Disney Resort gives about 20 minutes to the park. From Shinjuku, about 40. The further out your base, the more the night before is worth.

👉 The bag trick for check-out day, plus same-date prices:
https://japanbystation.com/tokyo-disney-hotel-night-before-or-after
